description: This file defines two reusable UI form components, TextField and SelectField, for a frontend application using qwik framework. These components encapsulate labeled input and select HTML elements with configurable properties and event handlers.

methods.name: handleInput$
methods.description: Event handler for input events in TextField component, calls user-defined callback if provided.

methods.name: handleChange$
methods.description: Event handler for change events in SelectField component, calls user-defined callback if provided.
